Source: molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join: molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno from parent CHEMBL3182437; molecule_dictionary child on molregno; compound_structures on molregno; compound_records on molregno; docs on doc_id; activities on record_id; assays on assay_id; target_dictionary on tid. Filter: parent chembl_id equals CHEMBL3182437; target chembl_id equals CHEMBL3430885; standard_type equals IC50. Sort: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
